ticker: India-Pakistan naval collision in Arabian Sea
UPI fee structure updated for merchants
SK Hynix in talks with Intel

articles.headline: India Protests Naval Collision with Pakistan
articles.whyItMatters: Heightens bilateral naval tensions in international shipping lanes.
articles.brief: New Delhi summoned Islamabad's envoy after an Indian warship and a Pakistan Navy vessel collided in the Arabian Sea, causing no major damage.

articles.headline: India Implements UPI Fee Shake-Up
articles.whyItMatters: Ends the completely free digital payment era for large merchants.
articles.brief: India introduces a fee structure on large merchant transactions via UPI, prompting heavy political debate and restructuring digital payment economics.

articles.headline: Cabinet Raises EPFO Wage Ceiling to ₹25,000
articles.whyItMatters: Brings millions of additional workers into mandatory social security coverage.
articles.brief: The Union Cabinet officially approved raising the Employee's Provident Fund Organisation wage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia Declares Mecca Attack a Red Line
articles.whyItMatters: Deepens regional instability as Houthi drone threats target holy sites.
articles.brief: Saudi forces intercepted a drone near Mecca, escalating security alerts and drawing international concern over ongoing Middle East conflicts.

articles.headline: SK Hynix Discusses US Chip Partnership with Intel
articles.whyItMatters: Could reshape domestic semiconductor supply chains and manufacturing footprints.
articles.brief: SK Hynix is reportedly in advanced discussions with Intel to manufacture memory chips inside the United States for the first time.

articles.headline: Oracle Executes Second Major Layoff Round
articles.whyItMatters: Reflects ongoing corporate restructuring and cost-cutting across global tech firms.
articles.brief: Oracle reused its earlier termination emails to lay off mid-to-senior level employees globally, impacting hundreds of workers in India.

articles.headline: New Zealand Parliament Passes India Trade Pact
articles.whyItMatters: Reduces bilateral trade barriers and expands market access for exports.
articles.brief: New Zealand's parliament successfully passed a comprehensive trade agreement with India, significantly cutting tariffs on a majority of mutual export goods.

articles.headline: High Prolactin Linked to Pregnancy Loss
articles.whyItMatters: Provides vital diagnostic insights for hormonal and fertility health management.
articles.brief: Medical experts highlight the importance of prolactin screening during comprehensive hormonal evaluations for women dealing with recurrent fertility challenges.

articles.headline: Bharat Forge Partners for HALE Drone Program
articles.whyItMatters: Bolsters India's domestic defense manufacturing and Atmanirbhar Bharat UAV push.
articles.brief: Bharat Forge and Pratt & Whitney Canada have joined forces to evaluate turboprop engines for the DRDO's high-altitude long-endurance drone initiative.

articles.headline: India Ranks 131 on Global Gender Gap
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights persistent challenges in national gender parity indexes.
articles.brief: India's position on the global gender gap index remains unchanged at 131, while Nordic countries continue to lead worldwide rankings.

articles.headline: Gold Hallmarking Fees Up by 67 Percent
articles.whyItMatters: Increases compliance costs for precious metal jewelry manufacturers and retailers.
articles.brief: The Bureau of Indian Standards has hiked hallmarking fees significantly, introducing new charging schedules for gold and silver articles.

articles.headline: Canada Evaluates EU Associate Membership
articles.whyItMatters: Could deeply integrate North American and European defense and trade policies.
articles.brief: European Commission leadership has proposed Canada as the EU's first associate member to enhance cross-continental strategic collaboration.
